title: Maximal subextension of $m$-subharmonic functions
summary: In this paper, we prove that given a quasi-$m$-hyperconvex domain $Ω\subset X$ in a compact Kähler manifold $(X, ω)$, and a function $\varphi $ in the weighted energy class $\mathcal{E}_χ^m(Ω, ω)$ with respect to a convex weight function $χ: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, then there exists a maximal $ω$-$m$-subharmonic subextension $\tilde{\varphi}$ to $X$ that preserves the weighted energy and satisfies good control properties for its Hessian measure $\mathbf{1}_ΩH_m(\tilde{\varphi}) \leq \mathbf{1}_ΩH_m(\varphi)$.
